sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.

sentences.en: A powerful group supporting Israel is trying to defeat sitting members of Congress who have criticized the country's deadly war against Hamas.
sentences.zh: 一个支持以色列的强大组织正试图击败国会中批评该国对哈马斯进行致命战争的现任议员。

sentences.en: In today's Democratic primary in New York, it appears that strategy may work.
sentences.zh: 在今天纽约举行的民主党初选中，这一策略似乎正在发挥作用。

sentences.en: My colleague, Nick Fandos, explains.
sentences.zh: 我的同事尼克·范多斯对此进行了阐述。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, June 25th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月25日，星期二。

sentences.en: Nick, by the time people listen to this episode, voting will have begun in this congressional race that Democrats across the country are watching really closely
sentences.zh: 尼克，当人们听到这期节目时，全国各地的民主党人都在密切关注的这场国会竞选的投票已经开始了

sentences.en: because, in a way, it feels like it's become a test of what a Democrat in office, in Congress, can or can't say about the war in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 因为在某种程度上，这感觉就像是对在职国会议员对于加沙战争能说或不能说些什么的一次考验。

sentences.en: So let's start at the beginning with the congressman who is at the center of this race.
sentences.zh: 那我们就从头说起，聊聊这场竞选的核心国会议员。

sentences.en: So we're talking here about Congressman Jamal Bowman.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里谈论的是国会议员贾马尔·鲍曼。

sentences.en: He represents the district just north of New York City.
sentences.zh: 他代表的选区就在纽约市正北方。

sentences.en: That includes parts of the Bronx and cities like Yonkers and Mount Vernon, but also suburbs like Larchmont and Scarsdale.
sentences.zh: 其中包括布朗克斯的一部分以及扬克斯和弗农山等城市，还有拉奇蒙特和斯卡斯代尔等郊区。

sentences.en: He's a former middle school principal, lifelong educator who was never in politics until
sentences.zh: 他曾是一名初中校长、终身教育工作者，直到

sentences.en: 2019 and 2020 when he decided,
sentences.zh: 2019年和2020年他决定参选之前，从没有涉足政治

sentences.en: I'm going to take on a big, powerful incumbent in my district.
sentences.zh: 我打算挑战我选区里一个资深且强大的现任议员。

sentences.en: Why run for Congress?
sentences.zh: 为什么要竞选国会议员？

sentences.en: The simple answer is I want to do everything in my power to meet the needs of my students and families beyond the classroom.
sentences.zh: 简单的回答是，我希望尽我所能，在教室之外满足我的学生和家庭的需求。

sentences.en: And he did it from the left.
sentences.zh: 他是从左翼发起挑战的。

sentences.en: When you look throughout the district, you see pockets of the district where poverty is higher than 20%.
sentences.zh: 如果你环顾整个选区，你会发现有些地区的贫困率高于20%。

sentences.en: You see pockets where the rent burdens are as high as 57%.
sentences.zh: 你会发现有些地区的租金负担高达57%。

sentences.en: While in other parts of the district, you see incredible wealth and incredible affluence and incredible opportunity.
sentences.zh: 而在选区的其他地方，你会看到难以置信的财富、奢华和机遇。

sentences.en: So remember, this was right at the height of the COVID pandemic.
sentences.zh: 所以请记住，这正值新冠疫情最严重的时候。

sentences.en: The election actually took place in the weeks after the killing of George Floyd.
sentences.zh: 这场选举实际上发生在乔治·弗洛伊德遇害后的几周内。

sentences.en: And the whole country was up in arms, was really thinking about race and equity, was thinking about power and whether the United States was moving quickly enough
sentences.zh: 整个国家都群情激愤，在认真思考种族和平等问题，思考权力和美国的发展速度是否足够快

sentences.en: towards the goals that it professes to have.
sentences.zh: 以实现其自诩拥有的目标。

sentences.en: I want to put my run for Congress on the side for a moment and just speak to you as a Black man in America and as someone who's lived there his entire life.
sentences.zh: 我想暂时把我的国会竞选放在一边，仅以一个在美国生活的黑人、一个在那儿生活了一辈子的人的身份跟你们聊聊。

sentences.en: And Bowman was really able to capture that energy as a younger Black man who was not in politics, speaks like a real person.
sentences.zh: 而鲍曼确实成功捕捉到了那种能量：他是一个不从政的年轻黑人男性，说话像个真正的人。

sentences.en: I never saw anyone that looked like me, that sounded like me, that came from the places that I've come from, that spoke the language that mattered to me.
sentences.zh: 我从来没见过任何人，长得像我，声音像我，来自我出身的地方，说着对我而言重要的语言。

sentences.en: For Bowman, the race was about race and policing and Donald Trump and the feeling that the Democratic Party was not fighting hard enough, fast enough on all of these issues.
sentences.zh: 对鲍曼来说，这场竞选关乎种族、警务、唐纳德·特朗普，以及一种民主党在所有这些议题上斗争得不够努力、不够迅速的感觉。

sentences.en: I never saw anyone centering poverty and the working class and immigrants and those who are most vulnerable in our country.
sentences.zh: 我从未见过任何人把贫困、工人阶级、移民以及我们国家中最弱势的群体放在中心位置。

sentences.en: And his slogan was jobs and education, not bombs and incarceration.
sentences.zh: 他的竞选口号是：要工作和教育，不要炸弹和监禁。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: My name is Jamal Bowman.
sentences.zh: 我叫贾马尔·鲍曼。

sentences.en: I'm running for Congress in this district, the 16th District.
sentences.zh: 我正在这个选区竞选国会议员，也就是第16选区。

sentences.en: Please go out and vote and thank you for considering us as your next congressman.
sentences.zh: 请大家踊跃投票，感谢你们考虑让我们成为你们的下一任国会议员。

sentences.en: Now, his opponent, Elliot Engel, was in his 70s.
sentences.zh: 现在，他的对手埃利奥特·恩格尔已经70多岁了。

sentences.en: He'd been in Congress more than 30 years.
sentences.zh: 他在国会待了30多年。

sentences.en: He's a committee chairman who was definitely more moderate than Bowman.
sentences.zh: 他是一位委员会主席，绝对比鲍曼更温和。

sentences.en: So in a sense, this becomes a perfect distillation of the outsider versus the establishment insider at a moment, like you just said, where that is the question of the moment.
sentences.zh: 所以从某种意义上说，这成了局外人对决建制派内幕人士的完美缩影，正如你刚才所说，这正是当下的核心问题。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And Bowman was really able to capitalize on a couple of instances where Engel looked out of touch.
sentences.zh: 鲍曼确实充分利用了恩格尔显得脱节的几次事件。

sentences.en: In one case, he was caught having stayed in Washington for the early weeks and months of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 其中一次，他被发现在疫情的头几周和几个月里一直待在华盛顿。

sentences.en: Instead of in his district.
sentences.zh: 而不是在他的选区里。

sentences.en: Far away from his district.
sentences.zh: 远离他的选区。

sentences.en: Yeah, far away from his district.
sentences.zh: 是的，远离他的选区。

sentences.en: And then when he does show up, he's caught on a hot mic begging for a speaking slot at an event.
sentences.zh: 然后当他终于现身时，他在一个开着麦的直播中被抓包，哀求在一个活动上获得发言机会。

sentences.en: And it's just too many folks here.
sentences.zh: 这里的人实在是太多了。

sentences.en: If I didn't have a primary, I wouldn't care.
sentences.zh: 如果我没有初选危机，我才不在乎呢。

sentences.en: Say that again?
sentences.zh: 请再说一遍？

sentences.en: If I didn't have a primary, I wouldn't care.
sentences.zh: 如果我没有初选危机，我才不在乎呢。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: Because that, don't do that to me.
sentences.zh: 因为那样做……别对我这样。

sentences.en: We don't do this.
sentences.zh: 我们不这么做。

sentences.en: We don't have a primary.
sentences.zh: 我们没有初选。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I remember that moment.
sentences.zh: 我记得那一刻。

sentences.en: It was incredibly embarrassing because here's a congressman already under fire for being MIA from his district in the pandemic saying, I need to talk at this news conference,
sentences.zh: 这实在令人尴尬，因为一个本就因在疫情期间消失在选区而饱受攻击的国会议员竟然说：我需要在这次新闻发布会上发言，

sentences.en: not because I necessarily care, but because I'm in a primary battle against Jamal Bowman and I need voters to see me speaking and to think that I care.
sentences.zh: 不是因为我有多在乎，而是因为我正与贾马尔·鲍曼进行初选之争，我需要选民看到我发言并认为我在乎。

sentences.en: That's certainly what it looks like.
sentences.zh: 看起来确实如此。

sentences.en: And Bowman, on the other hand, seems so in and of this moment that come election day, he sails.
sentences.zh: 而另一方面，鲍曼看起来如此契合当下的时代，以至于到了选举日，他一路高歌猛进。

sentences.en: He beats Engel by double digits.
sentences.zh: 他以两位数的优势击败了恩格尔。

sentences.en: And it's received at the time as kind of proof of the left's ascendancy.
sentences.zh: 当时这被视为左翼崛起的某种证明。

sentences.en: This is only a couple of years after Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez won her seat.
sentences.zh: 这距离亚历山大·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯赢得她的席位才过去几年。

sentences.en: The Squad formed in Washington, that far left group of lawmakers.
sentences.zh: “小队”在华盛顿组建，那是那群极左翼的国会议员。

sentences.en: And when Bowman arrives in Washington, he reinforces their ranks and adds to this kind of growing progressive block that in the early days of the Biden administration
sentences.zh: 当鲍曼抵达华盛顿后，他壮大了他们的队伍，并为这个不断壮大的进步派集团增添了力量，在拜登政府的早期日子里

sentences.en: seems to be exercising a lot of power.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎在行使很大的权力。

sentences.en: And one really emblematic moment where Bowman and the Squad try and flex their muscle is around President Biden's signature infrastructure bill.
sentences.zh: 一个极具象征意义的时刻是，鲍曼和“小队”试图展现实力，围绕拜登具有标志性的基础设施法案展开博弈。

sentences.en: Remember, this is a big trillion-dollar program to build roads and bridges and replace lead pipes.
sentences.zh: 记住，这是一个耗资数万亿美元的大型项目，旨在修建道路和桥梁、更换铅管。

sentences.en: And originally, there had been a Democratic proposal to pair it with another bill more focused on climate change and some social policy that progressives really liked.
sentences.zh: 最初，曾有一项民主党提案，计划将其与另一项更关注气候变化以及进步派真正喜爱的某些社会政策的法案捆绑在一起。

sentences.en: And the two get split apart.
sentences.zh: 结果这两项法案被分开了。

sentences.en: And the left is really upset about that.
sentences.zh: 左翼对此感到非常不满。

sentences.en: So in order to try and get negotiating leverage to get that other climate bill passed,
sentences.zh: 因此，为了争取谈判筹码以推动另一项气候法案获得通过，

sentences.en: Bowman and a bunch of the Squad and other progressives vote against the infrastructure bill.
sentences.zh: 鲍曼以及“小队”的一群人和其它进步派人士投票反对了基础设施法案。

sentences.en: Vote against one of Biden's biggest legislative priorities and say, it's not that we're against it, but we need to have both.
sentences.zh: 投票反对拜登最重要的立法优先事项之一，并表示：倒不是说我们反对它，但我们需要两者兼得。

sentences.en: So far, Nick, all of this very much feels in keeping
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，尼克，这一切都非常符合

sentences.en: with the way Bowman campaigned.
sentences.zh: 鲍曼的竞选方式。

sentences.en: He's governing as the outsider progressive that he said he would be.
sentences.zh: 他正按照他所说的那样，以局外人进步派的身份进行执政。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为没错。

sentences.en: He's pretty consistent and frankly is getting along all right in Washington.
sentences.zh: 他相当坚定，坦率地说，在华盛顿也相处得不错。

sentences.en: I mean, some people don't like those positions, but generally speaking, he's in good standing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有些人不喜欢那些立场，但总的来说，他声誉良好。

sentences.en: Until two very consequential weeks last fall.
sentences.zh: 直到去年秋天度过了极具决定性的两周。

sentences.en: And what happens in those two weeks?
sentences.zh: 那两周发生了什么？

sentences.en: So let me just set the scene here.
sentences.zh: 让我来还原一下当时的场景。

sentences.en: It's late September.
sentences.zh: 那是9月下旬。

sentences.en: Conservative Republicans are pulling Congress towards a government shutdown.
sentences.zh: 保守派共和党人正在把国会推向政府关门的边缘。

sentences.en: They're in on a Saturday.
sentences.zh: 他们在周六还在加班。

sentences.en: Things are a total mess.
sentences.zh: 情况一团糟。

sentences.en: Nobody knows if the government's going to be able to pay its bills or find a solution.
sentences.zh: 没有人知道政府是否能够支付账单或找到解决方案。

sentences.en: And in the middle of all of this,
sentences.zh: 就在这一切的中心，

sentences.en: Jamal Bowman is trying to rush to the Capitol to get to a vote.
sentences.zh: 贾马尔·鲍曼正试图冲向国会大厦去投票。

sentences.en: He gets to a door that he usually expects to go out.
sentences.zh: 他走到一扇他通常指望能通出去的门前。

sentences.en: It's locked.
sentences.zh: 门锁着。

sentences.en: He tries it.
sentences.zh: 他试着推了一下。

sentences.en: And then what does he do?
sentences.zh: 然后他做了什么？

sentences.en: He pulls a fire alarm.
sentences.zh: 他拉响了火灾警报器。

sentences.en: New York Congressman Jamal Bowman, the former school principal, caught red-handed pulling the fire alarm inside a House office building.
sentences.zh: 纽约州国会议员贾马尔·鲍曼，这位前学校校长，在众议院办公大楼内拉响火灾警报时被当场抓获。

sentences.en: It sends the Capitol basically into chaos, becomes a two-day news cycle.
sentences.zh: 这基本上让国会大厦陷入了混乱，并成为了持续两天的热点新闻。

sentences.en: He's a principal.
sentences.zh: 他是个校长。

sentences.en: In my schools, we did fire drills.
sentences.zh: 在我的学校里，我们进行过消防演习。

sentences.en: You know exactly what happens when you pull a fire alarm.
sentences.zh: 你非常清楚拉响火灾警报会发生什么。

sentences.en: All these national cameras are already paying attention, and now here's this crazy sideshow.
sentences.zh: 所有这些国家级摄像机已经把注意力集中在这里，现在又出现了这场疯狂的花絮。

sentences.en: He violated the exact same law that January 6th defendants are being prosecuted for every single day, interrupting an official proceeding.
sentences.zh: 他违反的法律与1月6日骚乱被告每天被起诉的法律完全相同，即干扰官方程序。

sentences.en: He said after the fact that he was trying to open the door.
sentences.zh: 事后他声称自己当时是为了开门。

sentences.en: But generally, you don't pull a fire alarm to open a door.
sentences.zh: 但通常情况下，你不会为了开门去拉火灾警报器。

sentences.en: His explanation that he did this by accident also false.
sentences.zh: 他解释说自己是无意中做这一举动也是假的。

sentences.en: It's the reason that I've asked the House Ethics Committee to review this.
sentences.zh: 这就是我要求众议院道德委员会审查此事的原因。

sentences.en: And eventually, Bowman is actually charged and pleads guilty to a misdemeanor for a false fire alarm.
sentences.zh: 最终，鲍曼确实被指控并对虚假火灾警报的轻罪认罪。

sentences.en: Listen, you know, I pulled the fire alarm.
sentences.zh: 听着，你知道，我拉响了火灾警报器。

sentences.en: I did not do it to disrupt the court proceeding, like I said.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，我不是为了扰乱国会程序才这么做的。

sentences.en: I was trying to get out the door.
sentences.zh: 我只是想出门。

sentences.en: I was rushing to a vote.
sentences.zh: 我当时正赶着去投票。

sentences.en: I'm thankful that, you know, we have an agreement in place.
sentences.zh: 我很庆幸，你知道，我们达成了一项协议。

sentences.en: I'm thankful in three months it's going to be dismissed.
sentences.zh: 我很庆幸三个月后它就会被撤销。

sentences.en: And now let's move on.
sentences.zh: 现在让我们继续前进吧。

sentences.en: He has to pay a fine and apologize.
sentences.zh: 他必须支付罚款并道歉。

sentences.en: And so it's just a real kind of black eye on his public image.
sentences.zh: 所以这对他公众形象来说实在是一个真正的污点。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Embarrassing, ill-advised, but at the end of the day,
sentences.zh: 令人尴尬、考虑不周，但在最后，

sentences.en: not anything that's going to necessarily endanger his career.
sentences.zh: 倒还不至于危及他的政治生涯。

sentences.en: Yeah, no, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错，确实如此。

sentences.en: I think if it had just been that alone, he gets past it.
sentences.zh: 我想如果仅仅是那样的话，他也就挺过去了。

sentences.en: But almost exactly a week later is October 7th,
sentences.zh: 但几乎恰好一周后就是10月7日，

sentences.en: when Hamas attacks Israel brutally,
sentences.zh: 当时哈马斯对以色列发动了残酷袭击，

sentences.en: takes hostages, leaves 1,200 Israelis dead,
sentences.zh: 劫持了人质，导致1200名以色列人丧生，

sentences.en: and really ushers in a new moment in American politics, and particularly for Democrats who have been divided on Israel for quite a while,
sentences.zh: 并且确实开启了美国政治的新时刻，尤其是对那些在以色列问题上分裂已久的民主党人而言，

sentences.en: particularly this kind of the left-wing squad from the rest of the party.
sentences.zh: 尤其是这部分左翼“小队”与党内其他成员之间。

sentences.en: And those divisions are just kind of blown up in the days and weeks after October 7th.
sentences.zh: 而这些分歧在10月7日之后的几天和几周内彻底爆发了。

sentences.en: And Bowman, of all people, throws himself right into the middle of the wreckage.
sentences.zh: 鲍曼偏偏把自己直接扔进了残骸的中心。

sentences.en: We acknowledge the trauma and the pain and the fear.
sentences.zh: 我们承认创伤、痛苦和恐惧。

sentences.en: He condemns Hamas' attack on October 7th, but then, just days later, calls for a ceasefire in the region, essentially saying,
